title: Prediction of acute toxicity for Chlorella vulgaris caused by tire wear particle-derived compounds using quantitative structure-activity relationship models
evidence: 完整原摘要明确QSAR使用genetic algorithm and multiple linear regression，进行内部与外部验证。
interpretation: 原判定将遗传搜索与普通回归一并视作不足以确认AI，过于保守；遗传算法为进化搜索，实质参与毒性预测模型构建，应以演化优化标签纳入；不推断q-RASAR具体算法。
